_note: xray: sha256 equals the official upstream Xray-windows-64.zip.dgst (SHA2-256). tun2socks: upstream publishes no checksum file, so the value is the SHA-256 measured from the official GitHub release asset (trust-on-first-use pin). wintun: pinned (same value amneziawg-windows-client pins). wireguard: Authenticode signature only. amneziawg: official signed MSI from the amnezia-vpn release, SHA-256 pinned (measured from the official asset) and Authenticode checked. openvpn: official OpenVPN Community MSI, version pinned, Authenticode signature (signer must be OpenVPN) is the check; it is only staged for the installer, never executed during the build. slipnet: upstream source cloned from the pinned commit and compiled for Windows during the build (AGPL-3.0).
